Are you looking for a tasty and high-quality snack for your cat? Our PREMIO Chicken Tuna Rolls combine tasty tuna and chicken and are therefore a perfect treat for your cat. The cat snack with high meat content is free of cereals and sugar and therefore not only tasty, but also excells with its high quality. In addition, the PREMIO snack comes with taurine, which supports the eyesight of your cat. The snack rolls also have a pleasantly soft consistency and are therefore easy to chew even for cats with dental problems.

Pamper your Cat with the delicious PREMIO Snack Chicken & Cheese Rolls! Our PREMIO Snack Chicken & Cheese Rolls are not only delicious, but also impress with their high-quality ingredients. With a meat content of 79%, the cat snack offers high-quality proteins that optimally complement the natural diet of your pet. Completely without added sugar and without gluten, the treat is also perfectly suitable for sensitive animals with intolerances. Particularly noteworthy is the addition of taurine to our snack. Taurine is an essential amino acid that strengthens the pet's vision and prevents deficiency symptoms. Whether as a reward or as a loving treat in between - the PREMIO Snack Chicken & Cheese Rolls are perfect for all occasions. With this treat you can promote the well-being of your pet without feeding unnecessary additives.
